recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, high-contrast profile portrait of a person at night, where the primary light source is positioned behind the subject, catching the texture of wind-blown hair while leaving the facial features in deep shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm golden backlight vs. cool deep black shadows
Sharp profile edge vs. soft motion-blurred hair strands
Static facial expression vs. dynamic movement of hair
coreInvariants: Golden rim lighting on the hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, captured from the shoulders up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing cluster of hair on the left side of the head acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright backlit hair on the left and follows the profile line down to the chin on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper right and lower left, rendered in near-total darkness.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle skin tones in the mid-shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the intense warmth in the highlights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic night shot of a person in profile. Use a single warm light source from behind to illuminate the hair. Ensure the face is 90% in shadow with only a faint rim light on the nose and forehead. Add motion blur to the hair as if caught in a breeze.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out sans-serif in a muted gold color, placed in the dark negative space of the upper right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the face mostly in shadow?
Is the hair glowing from a backlight?
Is there a sense of motion in the hair?

adjustableVariables: Amount of motion blur in the hair
Visibility of facial features in the shadow
mustRedesign: Avoid clear visibility of the background
postGenerationChecks: Check for haloing artifacts around the profile
Ensure the black levels are deep and not washed out
Verify the light source feels motivated from behind
Confirm the profile silhouette is recognizable
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast rim lighting with a profile silhouette and motion-blurred textures to create a moody, nocturnal atmosphere.
